lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The density is highest in the region immediately posterior to the gills, with inter-blob distance increasing significantly towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal blob rows to create a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae individuals (remoras) visible beneath the ventral-lateral area and near the pectoral fin.
